links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT-4 bariatric surgery recommendations across two separate conversations
links.effect: Disparities between the two ChatGPT-4 conversations in 40% of scenarios; matched expert opinions in 30% of cases.
links.quote: In 40% of the scenarios, disparities were identified between the two conversations with ChatGPT-4.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's recommendations on 10 clinical bariatric surgery patient scenarios compared to survey responses from 30 expert bariatric surgeons, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
